scope: Approved copper, iron and gold outcrops used in game
preview: Original generated atlases retained unchanged. Canvas review crops alpha>=224 bounds, rasterizes to 16x16, 32x32 and 48x32, removes alpha noise, and composites existing terrain art. Palette previews recolor host rock and grass while preserving mineral colors.
proposedPlacement: Ore on dry flat ground touching the outside edge of a hill or mountain region, in short broken clusters following its foot. Never water, river, hill summit or mountain core. Keep a clear flat approach for miners; gold uses the same adjacency rule.

ironAppearance.rendering: One complete mountain outcrop per connected iron deposit, using foothill clumps or exposed seam ribs with both silhouette variants. Native family and variant are preserved; patches without family metadata use their aspect ratio. Each silhouette fits uniformly inside the footprint, with no biome recoloring or dark tiled texture.

production.mining: Existing timber door from resource-objects.png, fitted to the rock face only after development; native gold reward is paid after a completed miner visit.
